about: Candidate addons for the Workshop marketplace (source "upstream"): installed by the launcher straight from the author's repo, never re-hosted unless the licence is open and there is no .blp art. From the 2026-10-31 audit. Descriptions are ours. tools/addon-curate/curate.py reads this file; mods/SPEC.md (Upstream addons) has the rules.

seeds.description: A complete replacement interface: unit frames, action bars, bags, chat, nameplates and data texts in one package you set up in game.
Movable, resizable action bars that take over from the default bars, with optional buff and minimap modules.
Move, scale, hide or fade almost any frame on your screen.
seeds.notes: Repo is a server community's copy, not the original author's: check credit before approving.

seeds.description: Light, configurable unit frames for you, your target, focus, party and pets.
Compact party and raid frames: health, auras, range and threat shown as small indicators you place yourself.
Restyled nameplates with themes, and Threat Plates for tank and threat colours.
Shows buffs and debuffs above nameplates. An updated edition of the backport.
The original backport of PlateBuffs: buffs and debuffs above nameplates.
Cooldown numbers on every button, item and aura icon. Type /omnicc for options.
Icons that light up when a spell is ready, a buff is missing or an internal cooldown ends.
Build your own alerts for buffs, debuffs, cooldowns and resources, or import ones other players share.
An earlier backport of WeakAuras: custom alerts for buffs, debuffs and cooldowns.
A light damage and healing meter with fight segments and windows you arrange yourself.
A detailed damage, healing and threat meter with many display styles and plugins.
Clean scrolling combat text in separate frames, with overkill and overheal tracking.
An earlier, minimal backport of xCT+ combat text with in-game settings.
Raid leader tools: cooldown tracking, notes, ready checks, attendance and fight analysis.
Raid leading made easier: loot rolls and history, warnings, LFM spam and raid checks.
Small raid helpers taken out of KPack as their own addon.
Collects group-finding messages from chat into one sorted board by dungeon and raid.
Shows the shared health of both Halion phases and calls out when to switch realms.
Shows quest givers, objectives and turn-ins on your map and minimap, with data matched to AzerothCore.
A full map and quest guide: a big zoomable map, quest tracking, gathering nodes and more.
A light, modern-looking minimap.
A gear score on tooltips and the inspect frame, so you can judge a player's gear at a glance.
A revised GearScoreLite that keeps inspect and mouseover working with other frames, and does nothing in combat.
Gems, enchants, item levels and quality borders on the character and inspect frames.
A simpler auction house: clear listings, quick buying and one-click selling at a good price.
Auction, crafting and mailing tools for players who run their own trade.
A small button that targets the engineering auctioneer in Dalaran for quick access.
Your emblem counts in the vendor window, next to your gold.
All your bags in one window, with a bank window and search.
One bag window that sorts items into sections by type.
Hides opposite-faction chat spam in neutral cities, and shows it again outside them.
Plan and check paladin blessings, auras and seals for the whole raid.
A balance druid bar whose marker shows the time left on Eclipse.
Timers, warnings and sounds for raid and dungeon boss fights.
Extra tweaks for Deadly Boss Mods.
More than seventy small interface improvements in one addon, each turned on and off on its own.
Plan and save talent builds, then learn them in one click; glyphs and spec tabs included.
Threat-aware nameplates with an aura engine and flexible layouts.
Converts ratings on item tooltips into real percentages and shows stat changes against what you wear.
Small pop-ups when friends come online or go offline.
Tracks raid cooldowns and shows who has what ready.
A working raid finder in the social window: it reads raid group messages from chat and lists them.
Replaces the quest and gossip windows with a cinematic dialogue view.
Friendly, clear raid frames with click casting and raid debuff indicators.
A clear alert when you are stunned, feared, silenced or disarmed, with the time left.
Shows the spell you just pressed beside your character, so you see every key press land.
One window for the profiles of every addon that uses AceDB. Type /profiles.
Logs boss fight events for people who write boss timers.
Gathering nodes on your map and minimap, with data taken from the AzerothCore world database.
Damage numbers that rise from the nameplate of what you hit.
Extra fonts, bars and sounds for any addon that reads LibSharedMedia.
Adds spell, item, quest and achievement IDs to tooltips.
A clean, flat look for the default interface windows.
Modern-styled cast bar, chat and unit frames.
seeds.notes: Check its art: modern-style UIs often carry stock interface textures.

seeds.description: An ElvUI data text that switches specs and gear sets in one click.
Announces interrupts, defensive cooldowns and utility spells to the chat channel you pick.
Quest objectives, givers and items on your map, searchable from a database browser.
The quest and object database pfQuest reads for this client.
A catalogue of every wearable look to preview and plan outfits.
seeds.notes: Outfits need a transmog feature on the realm to be worn.

seeds.description: Dozens of small interface and convenience options in one panel: auto-repair, faster loot, quieter screens, map and chat tweaks.
A better world map: unexplored areas shown, dungeon and flight points marked, and a map you can move and scale.

seeds.notes: Its art includes textures named like stock icons (for example a bag icon): check them before approving.
seeds.description: A cleaner, modern-looking main action bar, with new art for the bar, bags and menu buttons.
Pop-up cards for the loot, money and items you receive, in a modern style.
Zoom and pan the world map with the mouse wheel and drag, like a modern map.
Tracks raid cooldowns such as rebirths, innervates and defensive spells, with bars that show who has what ready.
Shows the cheapest and quickest way to level a crafting profession, step by step, from what you have in your bags.

seeds.notes: Another edition of pfQuest (up:pfquest): both load as quest helpers, so a player should pick one.
seeds.description: pfQuest with a complete quest database for this client: objectives, givers and items on your map, and a database browser.
Arena enemy frames with trinket, cast bar, class and diminishing-return tracking.
Extended arena frames for enemies and your own team: cooldowns, trinkets, auras and diminishing returns.
Shows on item tooltips which classes and specs count the item as best in slot, and for which phase.
The original best-in-slot tooltip addon, backported: which specs want an item, shown on its tooltip.
Tracks important raid cooldowns, such as rebirths and soulstones, in small sortable bars.
Icons that show when a spell or item is ready, or a buff or debuff is up or missing. A light take on TellMeWhen.
Records where your gold comes from and where it goes: quests, loot, repairs, the auction house and more, per session and per day.
Fades the interface out after a few seconds out of combat and brings it back when you need it, for a cleaner screen.
Lists the mounts, companions and titles your character has not collected yet, with where each one comes from.

seeds.notes: Voice files are generated by its authors; check what it ships and how big it is.
seeds.description: Reads quest text aloud with generated voices, so questing plays like an audiobook.
A tab in your spellbook that lists the spells you can learn now and at later levels, with their cost.
A detailed combat analysis meter: damage, healing, absorbs, deaths, interrupts and more, in many modes.

seeds.description: Skins for action buttons and icons across addons that support it, with a set of skins included.
Slim, clean nameplates with cast bars, health text and auras.
Tracks your raid's cooldowns and shows them in configurable bars.
Buff, debuff and cooldown bars and icons, arranged and filtered the way you want.
Sorts and arranges raid groups in one click: tanks, healers and damage where you want them.

seeds.description: Browse the loot tables of every dungeon, raid, faction and crafting list in the game, from one window.

Adds Add Friend and Invite to Guild to the right-click menu of players.
Item levels and quality borders on the character and inspect panels, and your average item level.
A list of the enemy players in a battleground, with class, spec and health, to target from.
World map markers for dungeons, raids, world bosses, boats, zeppelins and portals; click a transport to see where it goes.
Colours player names by class in chat, the friends list, the guild roster and who lists.

seeds.notes: Its .toc lists both supported client builds.

Icons for your trinket and enchant procs and their internal cooldowns.
Exports your character's gear and talents as text for the community combat simulators.

seeds.notes: Installs the same Auctionator folder as up:auctionator: one or the other.
seeds.description: An extended Auctionator with extra small features for buying and selling.
Mailbox helpers: open all mail at once, quick replies, and address book and sending shortcuts.
An animated crosshair over your target's nameplate, so you never lose it in a crowd.
Your buffs and debuffs shown over nameplates, with timers and filters.
Stops addons from forcing full memory clean-ups, which cause short freezes.
